textRuns.value: How to read this chart. Common-cause variation = normal month-to-month noise inside the limits. A red point is a special-cause signal: this month's share is unusual compared with the 2015-2019 baseline. It is a prompt to look, not proof of a quality problem. R1 = point beyond a control limit. R2 = 8 months in a row on the same side of the centre line. Limits are Laney-adjusted when months vary more than a simple count model expects.
